patent-attorneys-and-agents-startup-ip-s.author: Ptoleme
patent-attorneys-and-agents-startup-ip-s.core: Posted in last 7 days Patent Attorneys & Agents - Startup IP Starter Pack Looking to Interview Patent Attorneys/Agents for a Startup IP Starter Pack Hi everyone, We’re a small team based in Research Triangle Park working on a practical IP Starter Pack for startup founders. We’re hoping to speak with a few patent attorneys and patent agents to understand what founders most often misunderstand or overlook early on. Topics we’re exploring include: When should a startup start thinking about filing? What should founders document before speaking with counsel? What disclosures can create problems later? When does a provisional application make sense? What are common mistakes around inventorship and ownership? What IP decisions are difficult or impossible to fix later? The goal is to turn practitioner experience into a free, practical resource for founders, not to promote any particular firm or service. We’d like to acknowledge contributors in the final guide, with permission, by including their name, practice/firm, and potentially a short quote or insight. If you’re a patent attorney or patent agent and would be willing to share your perspective, I’d appreciate hearing from you. Feel free to comment or message me.

south-florida-restaurant-workers-schedul.author: ButtGoup
south-florida-restaurant-workers-schedul.core: Posted in last 7 days South Florida Restaurant Workers - Scheduling, Pay & Harassment South Florida Restaurant Workers- Tell me your experiences Im conducting research in the South Florida restaurant scene. I am looking to speak with current or former restaurant workers about their experiences. Im particularly interested in stories pertaining to: Significant reduction in hours/shifts with no explanation Changes in scheduling after employees raised concerns Tip pool or tip distribution issues Unpaid work or being asked to be paid off the clock Overtime/pay discrepancies Sexual harassment or other serious workplace issues Favoritism Retaliation after raising workplace concerns Equipment and safety issues Racial or gender discrimination Im not looking for people that want to complain about how bad their manager(s) is or how bad their shifts are. Im looking for specific experiences that can be documented or corroborated. Im approaching this as a reporting project and i’d like to speak to people confidentially before drawing any conclusions If you’ve experienced something like this, please comment or DM me. You dont have to publicly identify yourself or your employer. If you are comfortable sharing, please mention the restaurant you work at or have worked at, how long you’ve been there, when or approximately when, what happened, and whether you have documentation (schedules, text, pay stubs, emails, etc.)

doulas-and-midwives-billing-medicaid-or-.headline: Doulas & Midwives Billing Medicaid or Insurance - State Reimbursement
doulas-and-midwives-billing-medicaid-or-.author: John Wayne Zimmerman
doulas-and-midwives-billing-medicaid-or-.core: Posted in last 7 days Doulas & Midwives Billing Medicaid or Insurance - State Reimbursement I'm building something I wish already existed: a state-by-state picture of how birth workers are getting paid, told by the people doing the work. Over the past few months I've been sitting down with doulas, midwives, advocates, and policy leaders to understand where reimbursement actually stands. Not the headlines. Not an AI summary. What's really happening on the ground. There are great trackers showing which states have passed Medicaid coverage for doulas and midwives. What they can't show is what happened next. Are birth workers actually getting reimbursed? Are the rates enough to sustain a practice? Is commercial insurance following, or is it still out of pocket? Where is it working, and where is it stuck on paper? Now I want to reach every state. I'm looking for people who are: - Doulas and midwives billing Medicaid or commercial insurance, or trying to - Advocates and policy leaders working on birth worker reimbursement in their state - People who know where the system breaks between "covered" and "paid" Open to a 30-minute conversation If that's you, drop your state in the comments or send me a message. If you know someone who should be part of this, please tag them below. Your tag is a warm introduction I can't get any other way. Every state has a story. I want to hear yours. #Doulas #Midwifery #BirthWork #Medicaid #MaternalHealthEquity #swishvo
